answer_raw:
The fastest option is an **H100 GPU Droplet** at approximately **$3.39/hr** as of July 2026 [6].

For a 7B model, the cheapest option that would run it at all is a **$4.00/month** Basic Droplet as of July 2026 [3], though you would likely need to use quantized models or heavy CPU optimization to make it functional [5].

## Comparison of LLM hosting options

| Option | Speed/Performance | Monthly Cost (Approx) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **H100 GPU Droplet** | **Fastest** (High-end inference) | **~$2,470/mo** (at $3.39/hr, July 2026) [6] |
| **Basic Droplet** | **Slowest** (CPU-based) | **$4.00/mo** (as of July 2026) [3] |

The H100 is the clear winner for speed, but note that GPU Droplets charge the full rate while powered off [6]. If you want a balance of cost and performance for a 7B model, you would likely look at the **Premium Intel/AMD** or **Memory-Optimized** tiers to get better CPU/RAM specs, but the exact monthly pricing for those specific tiers in 2026 isn't in what I found.
